relevance_note: Prospective HCM-phenotype cohort in which 'four cases with LAMP2' are described individually in Table 1 (two probands and their mothers, Subject 1 and Subject 2, 'with Danon disease').
method_note: Read the whole paper; a Python script in the scratch directory assembled the JSON, cutting table spans directly from the Table 1 row lines (patients as rows; spans run from the label cell through the cited cell), and the output was checked against Table 1 by eye. In scope: Proband 1 and Subject 1 (Family 1, LAMP2 c.64 + 1G > A) and Proband 2 and Subject 2 (Family 2, LAMP2 c.973delC, p.L325Wfs*21); Subjects 1 and 2 are the probands' mothers per Figure 1 and 2 captions. Proband 3 (PRKAG2), Proband 4 (genotype negative), Proband 5 (TTR) and the 100 HCM patients are out of scope; cohort_size 107 (73 patients + 34 relatives). Table 1 'Age (Year)' recorded as age at last evaluation (age at study), not onset. 'Clinical Course' column used for treatment_summary and heart failure ('Heart failure managed'). 'HCM phenotype' / left ventricular hypertrophy recorded as observed from the Table 1 title ('rare disease patients with HCM phenotype') together with each person's Max LVT; LVEF values (e.g. 16.9% in Subject 1) were not converted into a reduced-ejection-fraction feature because the paper does not label them abnormal. 'NSR' (normal sinus rhythm) was not used to exclude any arrhythmia item. 'PVC' is not defined in the table legend; recorded as printed. Inheritance 'inherited maternal' for both probands rests on Table 1 showing the same LAMP2 variant in each proband's mother (Subject 1/Subject 2); the paper never states testing in words or uses 'inherited'. Zygosity, variant type and pathogenicity are not stated per variant (the methods' ACMG statement is general), so left not reported. Proband 2's LGE pattern is said to be 'consistent with our previous publication (Figure 2) [30]', but the paper does not state that this patient was described there, so cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is null. Minor inconsistency: the Discussion says female patients had sub-endocardial LGE 'mainly in the anterior and lateral wall', while Table 1/Results give 'mainly in lateral wall' for Subject 1; the Results/Table wording was used. No stacked cells.
